-550.text: Cyrus the Great founded the Achaemenid Persian Empire after conquering the Median Empire

-539.text: Cyrus the Great conquered Babylon and freed the Jewish exiles

-525.text: Cambyses II conquered Egypt, adding it to the Persian Empire

-490.text: Persian forces were defeated by the Greeks at the Battle of Marathon

-480.text: Xerxes I invaded Greece and won the Battle of Thermopylae

-334.text: Alexander the Great began his conquest of the Persian Empire

-247.text: The Parthian Empire was founded by Arsaces I

224.text: Ardashir I overthrew the Parthians and founded the Sassanid Empire

260.text: Sassanid King Shapur I captured Roman Emperor Valerian at Edessa

651.text: The Sassanid Empire fell to the Arab conquests, ending ancient Persian rule
